hero.title: Vault Authoring and Operations Advanced
hero.description: Demonstrate your production-level Vault expertise in this intensive, lab-based exam.

announcement.text: You can take two free exams with the purchase of a HashiConf at TechXchange ticket.

whoShouldTakeExam.title: Who should take this exam
whoShouldTakeExam.description: You should take the Vault Operations Advanced exam if you are a Cloud Engineer with production-level Vault operations expertise. You will need to demonstrate your ability to deploy, configure, manage, and monitor HashiCorp Vault, and you must also be able to evaluate Vault Enterprise functionality and use cases.

details.name: Price
details.value: $295 USD, plus locally applicable taxes and fees. Free retake included.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prereqs: Vault Associate certification (strongly recommend, or equivalent experience required)
Linux skills such as list and edit files via command terminal
Experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including PGP and TLS
Information security fundamentals such as network security and RBAC
Understand the concepts and functionality of infrastructure running in containers including starting and stopping services, and reading logs
prerequisites.bottomDescription: Experience with Vault in a production setting is required.

renewCertifications.title: Renew Your Certification
renewCertifications.description: Understand your recertification options. Start by finding the scenario that applies to you and then evaluate your options. Know which exam version you passed by the 3-digit code on your credentials (badge and certificate).

linkWithImage.title: Visit our knowledge base
linkWithImage.description: Review and follow the rules and requirements for taking exams before you register for an exam appointment. You are responsible for following the identification, system, and physical space requirements.

relatedCertsFooter.title: Related Certifications
relatedCertsFooter.description: Expand your expertise with certifications that build on related skills and technologies. Explore the next step in your learning journey.
